description:
Policy settings

TIP: Lists the configured settings of a Settings catalog / Endpoint security policy, paged. Each item has settingInstance {settingDefinitionId, choiceSettingValue | simpleSettingValue | groupSettingCollectionValue, children}. Pass $expand=settingDefinitions to get each setting's displayName, description and allowed options alongside the value. Supports $filter, $top, $skip, $select, $expand, $count.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (5-15) so responses fit the model context. Use @odata.nextLink from the response for more rows.

name: list-configuration-policy-settings
